dataset.name: WTC 1 V8R capacity-bounded floor-flow feasibility audit
dataset.scope: Replace the unbounded V8Q flow gauge with exact lower/upper-bound circulation tests using V8P load intervals, V8L core-beam proxy laws and V8M geometry-compatible core-floor-perimeter transfer at declared relative drops.
dataset.warning: The V8L beam profiles are mechanical brackets rather than as-built assignments, and V8M is an equivalent membrane envelope. Passing a proxy case is necessary but not sufficient for a real load path; failing all bounded proxy cases identifies a missing or insufficient modeled path, not an event probability or demolition proof.

official_facts.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL
official_facts.fact: V8P digitizes the before/after impact core-column axial-force contours over Floors 93-99 and uses the published Table 4-20 core totals.
official_facts.confidence: high within the bounded V8P digitization

official_facts.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL_LIMITE
official_facts.fact: The isolated Case B core calculations did not converge and omitted transfer through office floors, perimeter walls and the hat truss.
official_facts.confidence: high; inherited from V8L source audit

official_facts.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL
official_facts.fact: The individually modeled moment-connected core-beam subnetwork contains 17 transcribed edges per office floor; the connected 79-edge orthogonal graph remains a figure-constrained reconstruction envelope.
official_facts.confidence: high for the 17-edge transcription; model hypothesis for the 79-edge envelope

official_facts.label: RESULTAT_MODELE_OFFICIEL_ET_HYPOTHESE_MECANIQUE
official_facts.source: V8M from NIST floor-truss geometry and published seat limits
official_facts.fact: The published-seat-capped membrane law computes vertical transfer from axial tension and geometry; the 44/94 kip seat values are not direct vertical spring capacities.
official_facts.confidence: high for the mapping rule; as-built pair assignments remain unavailable

edge_mapping.floor96_damage: Use V8L floor96_figure_damage removed edges in every bounded case.
edge_mapping.floor93_policy: No V8L edge capacity is extrapolated to Floor 93 in the primary audit.

port_mapping.distribution: Divide each V8M face transfer by its active floor count and then uniformly over the reconstructed boundary columns on that face; corner columns receive the sum of their two face shares.
port_mapping.direction: Symmetric signed capacity is an optimistic feasibility bracket because V8Q scalar signs do not recover the actual relative-displacement direction.
port_mapping.seat_warning: Never assign 44 or 94 kip directly to a V8Q port. Only use V8M's computed vertical component.

future_impact_replay.scope: Build a separate explicit aircraft-impact replay from official aircraft mass, velocity, attitude, impact floor and structural geometry before transferring damage into the fire/initiation model.
future_impact_replay.observation_to_test: Distinguish the aircraft fuselage from fuel, engines, landing gear and other debris observed leaving an opposite facade; do not describe an entire aircraft exit without a source-resolved measurement.
future_impact_replay.solver_warning: Blender is visualization only. High-rate contact, material failure and fragmentation require a validated explicit-dynamics solver or a documented reduced impact model.
